text_en: In the beginning when God created the heavens and the earth,
text_cn: 在起初天主创造了天地。

text_en: the earth was a formless void and darkness covered the face of the deep, while a wind from God swept over the face of the waters.
text_cn: 大地还是混沌（dùn）空虚，深渊上还是一团黑暗，天主的神在水面上运行。

text_en: Then God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light.
text_cn: 天主说：“有光！”就有了光。

text_en: And God saw that the light was good; and God separated the light from the darkness.
text_cn: 天主见光好，就将光与黑暗分开。

text_en: God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, the first day.
text_cn: 天主称光为“昼”，称黑暗为“夜”。过了晚上，过了早晨，这是第一天。

text_en: And God said, “Let there be a dome in the midst of the waters, and let it separate the waters from the waters. ”
text_cn: 天主说：“在水与水之间要有穹苍，将水分开！”事就这样成了。

text_en: So God made the dome and separated the waters that were under the dome from the waters that were above the dome. And it was so.
text_cn: 天主造了穹苍，分开了穹苍以下的水和穹苍以上的水。

text_en: God called the dome Sky. And there was evening and there was morning, the second day.
text_cn: 天主称穹苍为"天"，天主看了认为好。过了晚上，过了早晨，这是第二天。

text_en: And God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together into one place, and let the dry land appear. ” And it was so.
text_cn: 天主说：“天下的水应聚在一处，使旱地出现！”事就这样成了。

text_en: God called the dry land Earth, and the waters that were gathered together he called Seas. And God saw that it was good.
text_cn: 天主称旱地为“陆地”，称水汇合处为“海洋”。天主看了认为好。

text_en: Then God said, “Let the earth put forth vegetation: plants yielding seed, and fruit trees of every kind on earth that bear fruit with the seed in it. ” And it was so.
text_cn: 天主说：“在陆地上，土地要生出青草，结种子的蔬菜和结果子的果树，各按照在它内的种子的种类！”事就这样成了。

text_en: The earth brought forth vegetation: plants yielding seed of every kind, and trees of every kind bearing fruit with the seed in it. And God saw that it was good.
text_cn: 土地就生出了青草，结种子的蔬菜、各按其类，和结果子的树木，各按照在它内的种子的种类。天主看了认为好。

text_en: And there was evening and there was morning, the third day.
text_cn: 过了晚上，过了早晨，这是第三天。

text_en: And God said, “Let there be lights in the dome of the sky to separate the day from the night; and let them be for signs and for seasons and for days and years,
text_cn: 天主说：“在天空中要有光体，以分别昼夜，作为规定时节和年月日的记号。

text_en: and let them be lights in the dome of the sky to give light upon the earth. ” And it was so.
text_cn: 要在天空中放光，照耀大地！”事就这样成了。

text_en: God made the two great lights—the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night—and the stars.
text_cn: 天主于是造了两个大光体：较大的控制白天，较小的控制黑夜，并造了星宿。

text_en: God set them in the dome of the sky to give light upon the earth,
text_cn: 天主将星宿摆列在天空，照耀大地，

text_en: to rule over the day and over the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
text_cn: 控制昼夜，分别明与暗。天主看了认为好。

text_en: And there was evening and there was morning, the fourth day.
text_cn: 过了晚上，过了早晨，这是第四天。

text_en: And God said, “Let the waters bring forth swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the dome of the sky. ”
text_cn: 天主说：“水中要繁生蠕动的生物，地面上、天空中要有鸟飞翔！”事就这样成了。

text_en: So God created the great sea monsters and every living creature that moves, of every kind, with which the waters swarm, and every winged bird of every kind. And God saw that it was good.
text_cn: 天主于是造了大鱼和所有在水中孳生的蠕动生物，各按其类，以及各种飞鸟，各按其类。天主看了认为好。

text_en: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth. ”
text_cn: 遂祝福它们说：“你们要孳生繁殖，充满海洋；飞鸟也要在地上繁殖！”

text_en: And there was evening and there was morning, the fifth day.
text_cn: 过了晚上，过了早晨，这是第五天。

text_en: And God said, “Let the earth bring forth living creatures of every kind: cattle and creeping things and wild animals of the earth of every kind. ” And it was so.
text_cn: 天主说：“地上要生出生物，各按其类；走兽、爬虫和地上的各种生物，各按其类！”事就这样成了。

text_en: God made the wild animals of the earth of every kind, and the cattle of every kind, and everything that creeps upon the ground of every kind. And God saw that it was good.
text_cn: 天主于是造了地上的生物，各按其类；各种走兽，各按其类；以及地上所有的爬虫，各按其类。天主看了认为好。

text_en: Then God said, “Let us make humankind in our image, according to our likeness; and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the wild animals of the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth. ”
text_cn: 天主说：“让我们照我们的肖像，按我们的模样造人，叫他管理海中的鱼、天空的飞鸟、牲畜、各种野兽、在地上爬行的各种爬虫。”

text_en: So God created humankind in his image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
text_cn: 天主于是照自己的肖像造了人，就是照天主的肖像造了人：造了一男一女。

text_en: God blessed them, and God said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the air and over every living thing that moves upon the earth. ”
text_cn: 天主祝福他们说：“你们要生育繁殖，充满大地，治理大地，管理海中的鱼、天空的飞鸟、各种在地上爬行的生物！”

text_en: God said, “See, I have given you every plant yielding seed that is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree with seed in its fruit; you shall have them for food.
text_cn: 天主又说：“看，全地面上结种子的各种蔬菜，在果内含有种子的各种果树，我都给你们作食物；

text_en: And to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the air, and to everything that creeps on the earth, everything that has the breath of life, I have given every green plant for food. ” And it was so.
text_cn: 至于地上的各种野兽，天空中的各种飞鸟，在地上爬行有生魂的各种动物，我把一切青草给它们作食物。”事就这样成了。

text_en: God saw everything that he had made, and indeed, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
text_cn: 天主看了他造的一切，认为样样都很好。过了晚上，过了早晨，这是第六天。
